summary: NICE Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing eight press releases highlighting product recognitions, customer successes, and event announcements. The filings include Gartner Peer Insights recognition, a customer case study with Openreach, an integration with Epic, a conference announcement, analyst recognition, and various customer deployments. No material corporate transaction, strategic review, or special situation event is disclosed. The filing is routine and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
